title: Such a big stand and a small receptacle
text: Such a big stand and a small receptacle. The ash/butt storage compartment is so small.  I thought you would be able to fill this with water to ensure fire safety, but it's such a small thing it's barely worth it.  You would have to empty and clean this thing weekly,  if not daily depending on usage.
